content.name: Aaliyah Thompson
content.title: Junior Cybersecurity Analyst
content.summary: Junior cybersecurity analyst with a BCIT diploma, Security+ and a six-month security operations internship. Now triages alerts and phishing reports for a credit union in the Lower Mainland, and built a reporting button flow that tripled staff phishing reports. Practises regularly on home labs and capture-the-flag challenges.

experience.title: Security Operations Intern
bullets: Reviewed Microsoft Defender alerts daily for 180 users and escalated three confirmed malware cases to the IT manager.
Ran a Nessus scan of the office network and tracked 64 findings to closure with the infrastructure team.
Drafted an incident response checklist that the company adopted for after-hours events.

experience.title: Junior Cybersecurity Analyst
bullets: Triage 40–60 SIEM alerts a day in Microsoft Sentinel and escalate confirmed incidents to the senior analyst.
Built a one-click phishing report flow in Outlook with automatic sandboxing, which tripled reports from staff in four months.
Wrote KQL queries that flag impossible-travel sign-ins for 520 member-facing and back-office staff.
Keep vulnerability tickets up to date and prepare the weekly patch-compliance summary for the IT director.

education.details: Network security and Linux administration electives. GPA 84%.

courses.name: Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

achievements.title: Top 5 student team, regional cyber competition
achievements.detail: Placed fifth of 38 teams in a BC post-secondary capture-the-flag event in 2024.

achievements.title: Home lab project
achievements.detail: Run a home SOC lab with a pfSense firewall, Wazuh and two Windows victims; write-ups published on a personal blog.

interests: Volunteering at a youth coding club
